run_chars74k_handler: run the chars74k_handler function to import and yield Chars74k dataset images with labels
create_downloadable_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset object with URLs and checksums for the Chars74k English character dataset
extract_labels_from_paths: extract numeric labels from Chars74k image file paths using the _extract_label_from_path helper
generate_train_test_splits: generate train and test data generators from Chars74k tar archives using gen_data_for_categories_splits
load_splits_mat_file: load a Chars74k lists.mat file into a pandas DataFrame using _get_splits_df_from_file
